program:
app "Fridge" milk mint
table food_item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 10, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen
let short = count(food_item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "food running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each food_item sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
form food_item
describe:
Fridge, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- food item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 10; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the food item have its qty is at most its low.
Shows:
- text: short, "food running low".
- for each food item sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the food item for editing; a swipe removes the food item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the food item.
    - text: the kind of the food item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the food item to the qty of the food item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the food item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the food item to the qty of the food item plus 1.
- a form to add a food item.

program:
app "Juz progress Pro" book mint
table read juz num 1..30, pages num 1..20 = 20
let total = sum(read.pages)
round(100 * total / 604) "% of the Quran read" big
draw 100, 4
  rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
  rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(total / 604, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
each 1..30 as j
  let got = sum(read.pages where juz = j)
  stack card gap 1
    row
      "Juz" j bold grow
      round(100 * clamp(got / 20, 0, 1)) "%" faint
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(got / 20, 0, 1), 4 fill good radius 2
    if got < 20
      button "Mark read" tap add read juz = j, pages = 20 - got
describe:
Juz progress Pro, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- read: juz: number, 1 to 30; pages: number, 1 to 20, starts at 20. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- total is the total pages of read.
Shows:
- text: 100 times total divided by 604 rounded, "% of the Quran read".
- a drawing made of rectangles.
- for each number from 1 to 30:
  - text: "Juz", the number.
  - text: 100 times got divided by 20 kept between 0 and 1 rounded, "%".
  - a drawing made of rectangles.
  - if got is less than 20:
    - a button "Mark read"; a tap adds a read with juz set to the number, pages set to 20 minus got.

app "Stock" package slate
table item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?
let short = count(item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "items running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each item sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    i.name bold grow color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form item
describe:
